title: ROBIN SCHULZ x WATERMAT - TAKE IT SLOW (BULLIT)

lines.l: So we take it slow, and it feels like home
Take it slow, all you need is if I let it go
Hold the moment and let it in
Open your heart, oh can't you see
Flowers all around, they make you feel
Like there's so much more to life
Make it through the noise, look up and breathe
Think of all the moments you could feel
They're right in front of you
Kiss, all you need is here to play.
Oh, oh, oh, hold the moment and let it in.
